Run paired replicates for one scenario, with checkpointing

run_paired_scenario.Rd

Runs single_paired_rep for i = 1, ..., n_sims, in chunks of chunk_size replicates (in parallel via parallel::mclapply when n_cores > 1). After each chunk, all rows so far are written to checkpoint_file; if that file exists at the start, the run resumes from the replicates already completed.

Usage

run_paired_scenario(
  n_sims,
  seed,
  ...,
  n_cores = 1,
  checkpoint_file = NULL,
  chunk_size = 100
)

Arguments

n_sims

Number of replicates.

seed

Base seed (see single_paired_rep).

...

Further arguments passed to single_paired_rep.

n_cores

Number of cores (default 1).

checkpoint_file

Optional path of an RDS checkpoint file.

chunk_size

Number of replicates per chunk (default 100).

Value

A list with raw (one row per replicate, ordered by rep_id) and settings (all arguments, the package, R, rjags and JAGS versions, the git commit of the working directory, the hostname, a timestamp and n_failed). The number of failed replicates is reported with a message, and a warning is given if more than 1\

See also

single_paired_rep, summarize_grid_by_kappa
